header: One wide group photo with names
lead: The photo keeps its own proportions and is not cropped. A group photo is framed around where people stand.
caption: The caption says what the photo shows and when it was taken.
note: The note lists the names from left to right. It wraps on narrow screens but is never hidden, because only the note names the people.

image.alternative: Twenty colleagues stand in three rows in a paved yard on an overcast day.
